finite_algebra_recipe.basis_order: lexicographic exponent tuples in generator order, 0<=a_i<degree_i
finite_algebra_recipe.zero_case: z_i=0 and add closed equation c_i=0
finite_algebra_recipe.closed_residuals: source closed_equations plus (1-bit_i)*c_i for every quadratic

polynomial_recipe.product: factor over all source finite parameters, quadratic masks, selector range, and degree range
polynomial_recipe.only_external_variables: external_variables; formal algebra generators and V are bound by finite matrix/coefficient operations

representation_scope: Complete indexed determinant/coefficient/product polynomial specification with a materialized integer coefficient DAG. Indexed fixed-elliptic anchor factors are canonical when present. Rank-sized matrices, indexed products, and monomial expansion are not materialized.
arithmetic_scope: The compiler proves equality with the supplied guarded finite source. Identifying its input projection with Z additionally uses the source arithmetic proof and its cited inputs.
